hypotheses.exact_claim: The frozen pipeline recovers the three documented narrowband Voyager components in the pinned public sample.
hypotheses.null_hypothesis: At least one expected component is absent or outside the frozen frequency and drift tolerances.
hypotheses.test: Verify size and SHA-256, run turboSETI with the frozen manifest, and evaluate only the three preregistered windows.
hypotheses.success_gate: All three components are within 25 Hz and 0.02 Hz/s and the carrier is strongest.
hypotheses.stop_rule: Any integrity or recovery failure makes the benchmark fail closed.
hypotheses.allowed_claim: Known human-made signal recovered in the specified dataset.

hypotheses.exact_claim: The atmospheric harness recovers the published strong carbon-dioxide feature from a frozen WASP-39 b spectrum.
hypotheses.null_hypothesis: The harness cannot distinguish the CO2 model from the frozen molecule-free alternatives.
hypotheses.test: Fit a published spectrum with frozen CO2 and control models before any K2-18 b retrieval.
hypotheses.success_gate: Recovery and uncertainty calibration pass the preregistered positive-control protocol.
hypotheses.stop_rule: Do not interpret weaker target spectra until this control passes.
hypotheses.allowed_claim: The harness recovers the pinned published 4.3-micrometre feature, consistent with the CO2 band identified by the JWST ERS team; this is not an independent detection.

hypotheses.exact_claim: The harness reproduces the pinned GO 1981 NIRSpec water-template regressions and measures their sensitivity; the deposited products do not contain the direct planet-versus-star comparison needed to resolve their origin.
hypotheses.null_hypothesis: The public spectrum cannot discriminate the planetary and stellar explanations.
hypotheses.test: Fit the signed author water template independently to Eureka, Firefly and Tiberius with and without a detector step; run deletion, scale and assumed-covariance diagnostics; rank archived PHOENIX mixtures with identical multiplicative nuisances; reproduce the separate GO-1743 MIRI fixed-model constraint.
hypotheses.success_gate: Reproduce the frozen per-reduction z fingerprints without correlated-view voting, expose bin, detector, nuisance and assumed-covariance sensitivity, require M3 to rank above M1 in both stellar visits, and return PASS / science_unresolved with origin comparison not_evaluated.
hypotheses.stop_rule: If plausible models remain within the evidence threshold, report unresolved.
hypotheses.allowed_claim: The harness reproduces the pinned GO 1981 NIRSpec water-template regressions and exposes their reduction, detector-side, influential-bin, covariance, and nuisance sensitivity; no direct planet-versus-star origin comparison is available in the deposited products.

hypotheses.exact_claim: The public B3a linear-Gaussian engineering preflight meets every frozen smoke gate without using observed transit depths.
hypotheses.null_hypothesis: The public decision procedure does not adequately control unsafe over-specific classification or correctly classify omitted-model and signed-cancellation synthetic stress cases.
hypotheses.test: Run 648 deterministic public cases on the pinned Eureka grid with exact correct-covariance and naive-diagonal fits, separate generator/evaluator/scorer roles, and frozen recovery, coverage, pull, diagnostic-classification, and invariance gates.
hypotheses.success_gate: Every bundled B3a gate passes with no missing case, no denominator exclusion, verified source/template hashes, and byte-deterministic outputs.
hypotheses.stop_rule: Any unmet gate returns engineering_preflight_status INCOMPLETE; do not tune the revealed v1 suite, declare B3 complete, or authorize K2-18 b.
hypotheses.allowed_claim: The B3a public synthetic preflight executed all 648 cases but remains incomplete because unsafe-specific-classification and diagnostic-classification gates were not met.

hypotheses.exact_claim: A sealed hidden-truth suite establishes global molecular-attribution calibration and real-data readiness under the frozen molecule, stellar, instrument, covariance, and model-misspecification families.
hypotheses.null_hypothesis: The atmospheric evaluator is not globally calibrated or does not abstain reliably under hidden confounders and model misspecification.
hypotheses.test: Run the sealed B3b suite with independent truth custody and scoring, secret entropy, HMAC-derived identifiers, distinct generator families, frozen evaluator digest, and complete denominators.
hypotheses.success_gate: Every preregistered global calibration, power, coverage, abstention, provenance, secrecy, and independence gate passes at the full release sample sizes.
hypotheses.stop_rule: Any leakage, missing cell, scorer dependence, generator inverse crime, or failed gate keeps real_data_readiness not_established and blocks claim-bearing K2-18 b analysis.
hypotheses.allowed_claim: B3b has not been executed; global molecular-attribution calibration and real-data readiness remain unestablished.

hypotheses.exact_claim: Descriptively report whether the unchanged signed local 4.3-micrometre contrast criterion is met in both correlated published views of the historical GO-2722 C1 visit.
hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Not applicable to historical context; criterion_not_met means only that at least one frozen descriptive gate was not met.
hypotheses.test: Apply the already-committed GO-2372 R=100 grid, overlap-aware rebinning, signed GLS contrast, AR(1) sensitivities, and one-bin deletions unchanged to the two published correlated C1 NRS2 views.
hypotheses.success_gate: Both nominal correlated views are valid with A greater than zero and retrospective standardized contrast z at least 2; every rho=0.25 and rho=0.5 fit and every required one-bin deletion is valid with A greater than zero.
hypotheses.stop_rule: Every other successful execution is criterion_not_met under science_state not_applicable_historical_context. Never pool or vote C1 with C2/C3 or infer a GO-2372 comparison, molecule, origin, atmosphere, biosignature, life, B3/B3b completion, or real-data readiness.
hypotheses.allowed_claim: Both correlated historical C1 views had positive local amplitudes but retrospective standardized contrasts near 1.1, so the frozen context criterion was not met; science_state remains not_applicable_historical_context and molecular attribution is not evaluated.

hypotheses.exact_claim: The signed local 4.3-micrometre morphology in the pinned published GO-2372 G395H spectra is positive in both visits under both paired reduction views and survives the frozen covariance and deletion diagnostics.
hypotheses.null_hypothesis: At least one visit or correlated reduction view does not meet the frozen positive-morphology criteria, or a required covariance or one-bin-deletion diagnostic is nonpositive or invalid.
hypotheses.test: Using the metadata-selected GO-2372 G395H visits C2 and C3 only, fit the signed NRS2 4.3-micrometre local contrast separately to the paired Eureka and exoTEDRF views on one frozen overlap-aware R=100 grid; run full-GLS AR(1) and leave-one-output-bin-out diagnostics without cross-reduction voting.
hypotheses.success_gate: All four nominal cells are present and valid with A greater than zero and retrospective standardized contrast z at least 2; every rho sensitivity and every valid required deletion has A greater than zero; no required cell or diagnostic is missing or failed.
hypotheses.stop_rule: Every other execution is SCIENCE_UNRESOLVED / criterion_not_met. Never infer molecule identity, atmosphere, planetary origin, biosignature, life, independent confirmation, B3/B3b completion, or real-data readiness; this result cannot update H-K218-CO2.
hypotheses.allowed_claim: The frozen retrospective harness found a positive local 4.3-micrometre morphology in C2 but not C3 in either paired reduction view, so the repeatable-positive criterion was not met and the result is SCIENCE_UNRESOLVED; molecular attribution is not evaluated.

hypotheses.exact_claim: The signed local 4.3-micrometre morphology is positive in the public held-out GO-2372 o005 G395H visit across the frozen corrected extraction and covariance views.
hypotheses.null_hypothesis: The held-out morphology is nonpositive, extraction-sensitive, covariance-sensitive, or invalid under a required detector-level diagnostic.
hypotheses.test: Reprocess the pinned public o005 NRS2 detector data with frozen flicker-noise cleaning, pixel replacement, extraction variants, transit and systematics models, joint block-bootstrap depth covariance, null and injection calibration, and the unchanged local morphology contrast.
hypotheses.success_gate: Pre-unblinding null, coverage, and bias gates pass; the nominal contrast has A greater than zero and retrospective z at least 2; every required corrected extraction, baseline, covariance, limb-darkening, and deletion view remains valid with A greater than zero.
hypotheses.stop_rule: Do not open wavelength-dependent morphology until detector-level extraction and injection gates are implemented. The archived Stage-3 product alone cannot yield a claim-bearing result, cannot repair H-K218-G395H-MORPH, and cannot update a molecular, biosignature, life, B3/B3b, or readiness state.
hypotheses.allowed_claim: A public held-out GO-2372 G395H visit exists, but its archived Stage-3 extraction failed the metadata-only readiness gate and no wavelength-dependent morphology fit was run.

hypotheses.exact_claim: Methane absorption is robust across independent reductions, retrieval codes, observing modes and reasonable stellar and atmospheric model families.
hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Methane support is driven by a specific reduction, visit, detector, prior or incomplete alternative model set.
hypotheses.test: Run two independent reductions and retrievals, leave-one-visit-out fits, injection tests and the frozen robustness grid.
hypotheses.success_gate: Both primary analyses and at least 90 percent of QC-passing variants clear the frozen molecular-identity gate.
hypotheses.stop_rule: Disagreement between valid reductions yields pipeline_sensitive, not molecule_detected.

hypotheses.exact_claim: Carbon dioxide is independently recoverable in the expanded K2-18 b near-infrared data.
hypotheses.null_hypothesis: The apparent feature is explained by offsets, alternative absorbers, noise or analysis choices.
hypotheses.test: Require consistent G395H abundance posteriors and positive held-out predictions across reductions and retrieval codes.
hypotheses.success_gate: CO2 beats every preregistered alternative by the frozen global threshold in two independent analyses.
hypotheses.allowed_claim: CO2 is supported in the literature but locally unresolved.

hypotheses.exact_claim: DMS or DMDS causes repeatable K2-18 b absorption that is robust to reduction, binning, noise and molecule-inventory choices.
hypotheses.null_hypothesis: A flat spectrum, correlated noise, another molecule or reduction choice explains the apparent feature.
hypotheses.test: Use a preregistered broad model inventory, empirical multiplicity correction and an independent MIRI transit.
hypotheses.success_gate: Repeatable absorption in multiple sensitive bands clears molecular-identity and robustness gates in new independent data.
hypotheses.stop_rule: Sensitivity to binning, reduction, red noise or molecule inventory blocks detection language.
hypotheses.allowed_claim: Published signal of interest; not a robust molecular detection.

hypotheses.exact_claim: A Hycean ocean model predicts the observations better than physically plausible non-ocean interiors and atmospheres.
hypotheses.null_hypothesis: At least one non-ocean model remains competitive.
hypotheses.test: Compare self-consistent model families with common priors and held-out predictions for CO, CO2, NH3, H2O, haze, temperature and albedo.
hypotheses.success_gate: Ocean probability is at least 0.95 under every frozen prior family and each non-ocean model has delta ln evidence of at most -5.
hypotheses.stop_rule: Any competitive non-ocean model restricts wording to consistent_with.

hypotheses.exact_claim: A repeatable, sky-localized narrowband transmitter is present in the searched K2-18 b observations.
hypotheses.null_hypothesis: No signal meets the frozen criteria in the sampled bands, epochs, sensitivities and morphologies.
hypotheses.test: Reproduce the published VLA and MeerKAT search only if the request-only high-resolution products become available; require new independent observations for confirmation.
hypotheses.success_gate: Independent recurrence, sky localization and full RFI and instrument rejection.
hypotheses.stop_rule: An archive-only event cannot be promoted without independent repeat observations.
hypotheses.allowed_claim: The published search found no viable candidate in its declared search space.

hypotheses.exact_claim: Inner-planet and stellar controls constrain contamination strongly enough to interpret a frozen TRAPPIST-1 e spectrum.
hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Stellar activity or shared systematics can reproduce the apparent planetary feature.
hypotheses.test: Fit shared stellar terms across planets and epochs before testing e-specific atmospheric components.
hypotheses.success_gate: The e-specific component persists in independent visits after control-planet and stellar modeling.
hypotheses.stop_rule: Shared features across control planets block planetary attribution.
hypotheses.allowed_claim: A feature is or is not separable from system-level contamination.

hypotheses.exact_claim: Public spectra discriminate a secondary atmosphere or water-world interpretation from a mini-Neptune model.
hypotheses.null_hypothesis: The current data do not distinguish the physically plausible environment families.
hypotheses.test: Begin with published spectra and common-prior forward models; raw JWST work requires a separate storage gate.
hypotheses.success_gate: Independent analyses agree and held-out wavelengths discriminate the model families.
hypotheses.stop_rule: Model degeneracy yields unresolved rather than habitable.
hypotheses.allowed_claim: The data favor, or do not distinguish, specified environment models.

hypotheses.exact_claim: The classification pipeline recovers BLC1 as a signal of interest and rejects it as terrestrial interference after full-band analysis.
hypotheses.null_hypothesis: The classifier promotes an ON/OFF-like terrestrial signal or fails to reproduce its rejection evidence.
hypotheses.test: Use a frozen, license-reviewed, size-bounded published subset and reproduce the lookalike/intermodulation analysis.
hypotheses.success_gate: Initial recovery succeeds and final classification matches the published terrestrial explanation with auditable reasons.
hypotheses.stop_rule: Do not run a blind unknown-target search until the hard negative passes.
hypotheses.allowed_claim: The pipeline distinguishes a known radio false positive.

hypotheses.exact_claim: The pipeline correctly orchestrates and audits a complete ABACAD ON/OFF cadence.
hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Cadence ordering, forced OFF measurements or RFI-like injections are mishandled.
hypotheses.test: Activate the frozen 1.45 GB medium-resolution manifest and run injected cadence cases plus label permutations.
hypotheses.success_gate: Persistent ON-only injections are recovered; common-mode, OFF-only and malformed cadences are rejected with reason codes.
hypotheses.stop_rule: These medium-resolution files validate orchestration, not final narrowband sensitivity.
hypotheses.allowed_claim: ON/OFF cadence logic works for the tested cases.

hypotheses.exact_claim: The light-curve pipeline recovers shallow multi-sector transits with calibrated completeness.
hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Detrending or ephemeris choices bias recovery or timing measurements.
hypotheses.test: Recover known signals and run blind injection/recovery over depth, period, phase and variability conditions.
hypotheses.success_gate: Preregistered completeness and interval-coverage criteria pass in every declared core cell.
hypotheses.stop_rule: Failed cells are removed from the claimed domain or trigger a pipeline revision.
hypotheses.allowed_claim: Transit recovery is calibrated over the stated domain.

hypotheses.exact_claim: The light-curve pipeline recovers a sparse long-period transit without overstating completeness.
hypotheses.null_hypothesis: Long-period detrending or the small number of transits produces biased recovery and uncertainty.
hypotheses.test: Recover the known approximately 129.9-day signal and inject comparable long-period transits into frozen controls.
hypotheses.success_gate: Known-signal recovery and cell-wise completeness and coverage pass the frozen protocol.
hypotheses.stop_rule: Do not generalize beyond sampled periods, depths, duty cycles and data quality.
hypotheses.allowed_claim: Long-period transit recovery is calibrated over the stated domain.
